adjudicated_entries.what: GitHub Agentic PR Dataset (Abujadallah and Sayagh, ETS Montreal; CC-BY-4.0), table pr_test_quality, column `adapted`
adjudicated_entries.read: released parquet file (revision 8a44bdb6, downloaded to E: by t5a_ingest.py) and dataset card; tables added in commits of 2026-07-21 ('Add RQ2 test-quality and RQ3 review-depth tables'), documented 2026-09-27
adjudicated_entries.definition_verbatim: adapted | bool | The fix edits an existing test's expected values rather than adding a new test.
adjudicated_entries.reason: one row per PR (49,042 rows, 49,042 distinct repo_name+number keys) with is_agent; the stated definition is an edit of an existing test's expected values, i.e. oracle modification; operationalisation undocumented (the authors' arXiv 2606.13468 is the rejection study and does not define it), so criterion 5 (hand-check) decides
adjudicated_entries.disposition: NEAREST: stated definition matches, measured behaviour does not (criterion 5 failed: 5 of 20 label-positive agent PRs edit an existing expected value or tolerance, 0 of 20 label-negative PRs with a modified test file do; the label behaves as 'an existing test was edited' rather than 'an expected value was edited')

adjudicated_entries.what: Test Coverage Analysis of Agentic Pull Requests (Dipongkor, Baral, Lam, Moran; ICSME 2026), package SageSELab/Agentic-Pull-Request-Test-Coverage
adjudicated_entries.reason: PR label 'Modifies Tests' = changes test files without introducing a new test method (declared-name set unchanged); structural, says nothing about expected values or tolerances; 1,500 of 4,882 PRs

adjudicated_entries.what: Human-Agent versus Human Pull Requests: A Testing-Focused Characterization (Milanese et al., MSR 2026), Zenodo package
adjudicated_entries.reason: test-evolution task labels Add/Mod/Del on a stratified sample of 339 agent PRs (Pinto et al. taxonomy) plus test-smell deltas; 'Mod' is any modification of existing test code, not an expected-value or tolerance edit

adjudicated_entries.what: All Smoke, No Alarm: Oracle Signals in Agent-Authored Test Code (Banik, Chowdhury, Shamim), figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.32032107
adjudicated_entries.read: full text (arXiv HTML) and figshare file list
adjudicated_entries.reason: oracle-signal category (W1-W5, S1-S3) of the ADDED lines of each test patch; strength of assertions present, not edits to existing expected values; the paper itself notes modified-file patches are classified on added lines only

adjudicated_entries.what: An Empirical Study of Tests in Agentic Pull Requests (Haque, Ingale, Csallner; MSR 2026), figshare package
adjudicated_entries.reason: test inclusion, timing, size and merge outcome of test-containing PRs; no edit-of-existing-oracle label
